text: Traveling to a new country is an exciting experience. First, planning a trip can be fun, but it also takes time. You need to book tickets, find a hotel, and decide what to see. When you arrive, you meet new cultures, and everything feels different. Trying local food is one of the best parts of any journey. However, language barriers can be a problem. Sometimes you cannot understand people, so you use hand gestures or a translation app. In the end, these small challenges become good memories that you will never forget.
